evidence.AC1: POST /todos with {"title":"past","dueDate":"2026-10-01"} returned 201 with dueDate "2026-10-01". POST without dueDate returned 201 with dueDate null. The value is a date only, with no time.
evidence.AC2: PATCH /todos/4 with {"dueDate":"2026-10-05"} returned 200 and set the date. PATCH with {"dueDate":null} returned 200 and dueDate became null. PATCH with only a title change left the due date unchanged.
evidence.AC3: POST with dueDate "2026-02-30", "23.10.2026", "2026-10-01T10:00:00" and "nonsense" each returned 400. PATCH with "2026-02-30" and "bad" each returned 400. The error text is generic JSON-parse wording, but the status is 400.
evidence.AC4: Today is 2026-10-23. GET /todos?overdue=true returned only the todo due 2026-10-01 that was not done. The todo due 2026-12-01, the todo due today (2026-10-23), the todo with no due date and the done todo due 2026-09-01 were excluded. Each of those four showed overdue=false.
evidence.AC5: The list page at / showed due dates as dd.MM.yyyy next to titles, for example "past2 01.10.2026", "future 01.12.2026", "today 23.10.2026" and "pastdone ✓ 01.09.2026". The todo without a due date showed none.
evidence.AC6: In the page snapshot only the overdue todo (past2, due 01.10.2026) carried the text "überfällig". The future, today, no-date and done-past todos had no mark.
evidence.AC7: The page has a checkbox labelled "nur überfällige". After I clicked it, the list showed only the overdue todo (past2 01.10.2026 überfällig).
